name: MultiPOS – Point of Sale (POS) for WooCommerce, Barcode Scanner & Cash Register
author: DevDiggers

sections.description:
MultiPOS is a free WooCommerce point of sale plugin for shops that sell online and over a counter. It turns any browser into a cash register at a URL you choose, such as yoursite.com/pos.

A cashier opens that URL, logs in, and lands on the sales screen. From there they search products, scan a barcode, add a customer, apply a coupon, take payment, and print a receipt. The sale is saved as a real WooCommerce order, so your stock, taxes, coupons, customer records, and order list keep working the way they already do.

The free version covers a first POS setup end to end: one outlet, unlimited cashiers, WooCommerce stock, barcode scanning and label printing, receipt printing, customer management, and a POS dashboard. It suits small retail counters, grocery and convenience shops, pickup desks, market stalls, pop-up shops, and cafes that want in-person sales recorded inside WooCommerce instead of a separate till.

No monthly fee, no external POS account, and no store data leaving your site.

Quick Links

  • View Product Page
  • Live Demo
  • Full Documentation
  • Free vs Pro Comparison
  • Contact Support
  • Upgrade to Pro

What you get in the free version

  • A point of sale terminal on your own site, at a URL path you pick
  • Setup wizard for the first configuration
  • One active outlet, in grocery/retail or restaurant/cafe mode
  • Unlimited cashiers using a dedicated POS Cashier role
  • Product search by title, ID, SKU, or barcode
  • Barcode scanning to add items to the cart
  • WooCommerce stock check before the order is created
  • Cash payment with tendered amount and change, plus your own payment method labels
  • POS sales saved as normal WooCommerce orders
  • POS order marker in the WooCommerce orders list
  • Customer search, add, edit, and delete from the POS screen
  • WooCommerce coupon codes at POS checkout
  • Hold a cart and come back to it later
  • Receipt printing with configurable roll width, height, and margin
  • Barcode label printing for products, with page and label sizing
  • POS dashboard with orders, revenue, cashiers, and top payment method
  • Transaction log of POS activity
  • Login screen text, logo, and colour settings
  • POS colours, font family, font size, corner radius, and product card layout
  • Translation ready, .pot file included
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)

How it works

After activation, a MultiPOS panel appears in your WordPress admin.

  1. Run the setup wizard, or open MultiPOS > Configuration
  2. Enable the Point of Sale module
  3. Choose the POS URL path, for example pos
  4. Set up your outlet and enter its address
  5. Create a cashier from MultiPOS > Cashiers
  6. Open the POS terminal and take your first in-person sale

Cashiers never need WordPress admin access. They log in on the POS screen itself.

Free WooCommerce POS features in detail

Point of sale terminal on your own site

The POS terminal is a single sales screen built for a busy counter.

  • Open the register from a custom URL such as /pos
  • Administrators, shop managers, and POS cashiers can all get in
  • Search the WooCommerce catalogue by title, ID, SKU, or barcode
  • Add products by tapping a card or by scanning a barcode
  • See stock counts on the product cards
  • Pick the product card orientation from the admin
  • WooCommerce prices, taxes, and coupons apply exactly as they do online
  • Hold an unfinished cart and pick it up again later
  • Print the receipt as soon as payment is taken

Barcode scanning and barcode label printing

Barcodes work in both directions: scanning items at the till, and printing labels for the shelf.

  • Choose product ID or SKU as the barcode source
  • Print barcode labels from the admin product barcode screen
  • Set label page width, height, margins, barcode height, spacing, and orientation
  • Scan or type a barcode value at the POS to drop the product into the cart

Any keyboard-wedge barcode scanner works, which covers most USB and Bluetooth scanners. The scanner simply types the code into the barcode box, so there is nothing extra to install.

POS sales saved as WooCommerce orders

In-person sales land in WooCommerce, not in a separate ledger.

  • Every POS sale creates a real WooCommerce order
  • Set the initial order status for POS orders
  • Choose whether WooCommerce order emails go out after POS checkout
  • POS source details appear in the WooCommerce orders list
  • Review POS orders from the MultiPOS admin orders screen
  • Outlet, cashier, payment method, tendered amount, and table are stored as order meta
  • Stock is checked against WooCommerce before the order is created

Cashier logins without WordPress admin access

MultiPOS adds a dedicated POS Cashier role.

  • Add as many cashiers as you need, at no cost
  • Administrators and shop managers can use the POS too when they need to
  • Cashiers edit their own basic profile from the POS settings tab
  • Cashiers can review recent orders and the day’s cash movement from inside the POS
  • Cashier and outlet are attached to every order for accountability
  • Turn “remember me” and “forgot password” on or off for the POS login screen

Outlet setup for a retail counter or cafe

An outlet is the physical place where the selling happens.

  • One active outlet in the free version
  • Store the outlet name, address, phone, and email
  • Choose grocery/retail mode or restaurant/cafe mode
  • Pick which payment methods are available at that outlet
  • Mark the outlet active or inactive to open or close the register
  • Outlet address feeds POS tax handling and printed receipts

Restaurant and cafe mode adds a tables tab in the POS, so an order can be attached to a dining table you defined in the settings.

Payment methods and cash handling

The free version ships with Cash and lets you name the rest.

  • Cash payment with tendered amount and automatic change
  • Add your own payment method labels, for example Card, UPI, or Bank Transfer
  • Enable or disable each method, and choose which ones the outlet uses
  • The chosen method is saved with the WooCommerce order and shown in the transaction log

Splitting a single order across several payment methods and cash drawer tracking are Pro features.

Customers and coupons at the counter

Cashiers handle customer records without leaving the sales screen.

  • Search existing WooCommerce customers
  • Add a new customer in the middle of a sale
  • Edit or delete a customer when needed
  • Set a default guest account for walk-in sales
  • Apply and validate WooCommerce coupon codes at POS checkout

Receipt printing and printer sizing

The free version ships one receipt template, translatable through your normal WordPress translation files.

  • Print the receipt straight after checkout
  • Set receipt roll width, height, and margin to match your thermal printer
  • Set barcode label size and print orientation separately
  • Receipts carry outlet details, order details, customer details, totals, taxes, and payment data

Composing your own receipt layouts and managing more than one template are Pro features.

POS dashboard and transaction log

The admin dashboard answers the question “how did we do today”.

  • Summary cards for total orders, revenue, cashiers, and top payment method
  • Revenue chart with date range filters
  • Payment method breakdown next to recent POS orders
  • Recent POS orders table
  • Transaction list showing outlet, cashier, method, amount, and date
  • Search and filter on the admin lists

Branding the POS login screen

Small settings that make the till look like your shop.

  • Setup wizard on first activation
  • Turn the Point of Sale module on or off
  • Change the POS login heading, subtitle, footer, and button label
  • Upload your own logo for POS screens and receipts
  • Set login screen background, card, and text colours
  • Change POS colours, font family, base font size, and corner radius

For developers

MultiPOS is built on WordPress and WooCommerce hooks.

  • REST API namespace: ddwcpos/v1
  • Routes for products, categories, customers, countries and states, coupons, stock checks, order creation, order listing, and cashier saving
  • PHP hooks for order creation, POS access, outlet data, products, customers, transactions, and API responses
  • JavaScript filters and actions inside the React POS app
  • HPOS compatibility declared for WooCommerce custom order tables
  • Text domain: devdiggers-multipos-for-woocommerce

MultiPOS Pro

Pro is for stores that outgrow a single counter: more branches, more payment flows, or a kitchen to feed.

Multiple outlets and staff

  • Unlimited outlets
  • Assign different cashiers to different outlets
  • Outlet-specific workflows
  • Outlet stock controls for multi-location inventory

Advanced checkout

  • Variable products alongside simple products
  • Multiple and split payments on one order
  • Order notes at POS checkout
  • Custom product entries typed at the till
  • Weight or unit based pricing
  • Cash drawer tracking
  • Custom barcode value per product
  • Offline order handling with later sync

Restaurant and kitchen

  • Kitchen display URL
  • Send held orders to the kitchen
  • Restaurant table workflows
  • Dine-in and takeaway handling
  • Print a held order receipt to collect payment
  • Kitchen preparation status tracking

Reports and inventory

  • Dedicated POS reports with filters and exports
  • Revenue stats by date range
  • Product performance reports
  • Coupon usage reports
  • Order statistics by outlet
  • Tax reports and summaries
  • Outlet-specific stock editing

App and receipts

  • Progressive Web App configuration
  • Custom app name, icon, splash colour, and theme colour
  • More product and variation display options
  • Full receipt composer and multiple receipt templates

Upgrade to MultiPOS Pro

External services

This plugin relies on the following third-party services provided by DevDiggers (https://devdiggers.com). These connections only happen inside the WordPress admin area and are described below so you know exactly what is sent, why, and when.

1. DevDiggers extensions directory

  • What it is: A read-only API on devdiggers.com that returns the public list of DevDiggers WooCommerce extensions.
  • What it is used for: To display available DevDiggers extensions on the plugin’s “Extensions” admin page.
  • When data is sent: Only when a logged-in administrator opens the “Extensions” admin page. The response is cached for 24 hours, so the request is not repeated on every page load.
  • What data is sent: A standard outbound HTTP request only (your server’s IP address and a plugin user-agent string, as with any web request). No personal data and no store data are sent.
  • Endpoint: https://devdiggers.com/wp-json/ddwcs/v1/plugins

2. Newsletter subscription (optional)

  • What it is: A contact/newsletter endpoint on devdiggers.com.
  • What it is used for: To add your email address to the DevDiggers newsletter, only if you explicitly choose to subscribe.
  • When data is sent: Only when an administrator submits the optional newsletter form in the plugin dashboard. Nothing is sent automatically.
  • What data is sent: The email address you enter and your site URL.
  • Endpoint: https://devdiggers.com/

These services are provided by DevDiggers. By using them you agree to the DevDiggers Terms and Conditions (https://devdiggers.com/terms-and-conditions/) and Privacy Policy (https://devdiggers.com/privacy-policy/).

Source code and build tools

The JavaScript and CSS shipped in this plugin are compiled with webpack. The complete, human-readable source code (including the POS React app, admin, login, dashboard and user-page scripts/styles, the bundled framework source, and all build configuration) is published in our public GitHub repository:

https://github.com/DevDiggers-Technologies/multipos-for-woocommerce

To rebuild the compiled assets from source:

  1. Clone the repository above and install Node.js (16+).
  2. Run npm install to install the build dependencies listed in package.json.
  3. Run npm run build to generate the production files in assets/js/ and assets/css/.

Build tools used: webpack, Babel, and the @wordpress/* script dependencies declared in package.json.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin.
  2. Search for MultiPOS.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the zip file, click Install Now, then Activate.

You can also upload the devdiggers-multipos-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/ over FTP, then activate it from the Plugins menu.

After activation

  1. Follow the setup wizard, or go to MultiPOS > Configuration > General.
  2. Enable the Point of Sale module.
  3. Set your POS terminal URL path.
  4. Configure your outlet from MultiPOS > Outlet.
  5. Create a cashier from MultiPOS > Cashiers.
  6. Open the register using the Visit POS link.
sections.faq:
Is MultiPOS really free?

Yes. The free version runs a full counter: one outlet, unlimited cashiers, barcode scanning, barcode label printing, receipt printing, customers, coupons, cash payment, and the POS dashboard. There is no trial period and nothing stops working after a while. Pro adds multiple outlets, split payments, restaurant kitchen tools, and detailed reports.

Do POS sales show up as normal WooCommerce orders?

Yes. Each sale creates a real WooCommerce order. MultiPOS attaches the outlet, cashier, payment method, and tendered amount, but the order lives in WooCommerce and behaves like any other order.

What do I need to run it besides WooCommerce?

A computer or tablet with a browser, and your existing WooCommerce products. WordPress 6.0 or newer, WooCommerce 9.0 or newer, and PHP 7.4 or newer.

Do I need a barcode scanner?

No, but it speeds things up. Any keyboard-wedge USB or Bluetooth scanner works, because the scanner just types the barcode into the POS barcode box. You can also type or paste the value by hand.

Can I print barcode labels for my products?

Yes. The admin barcode screen prints labels and lets you set page size, barcode height, margins, spacing, and orientation. Free uses the product ID or SKU as the barcode value. Assigning your own custom barcode value per product is a Pro feature.

Can I print receipts on a thermal printer?

Yes. Receipts print from the browser after checkout, and you can set the roll width, height, and margin to match your printer. The free version ships one translatable receipt template. Designing your own templates is a Pro feature.

Which payment methods can I take at the counter?

Cash is included, with tendered amount and change. You can also add your own payment method labels in MultiPOS > Configuration > Payments, for example Card or UPI, and choose which ones the outlet offers. Splitting one order across several methods is a Pro feature.

How many cashiers can I add?

As many as you like. The free version creates a POS Cashier role and does not limit how many users you assign to it. Administrators and shop managers can also use the POS. Assigning different cashiers to different outlets needs Pro, because the free version runs one outlet.

Can I run more than one shop or register location?

The free version supports one active outlet. MultiPOS Pro adds unlimited outlets for stores with more than one branch or sales location.

Does it use my WooCommerce stock?

Yes. The POS reads WooCommerce stock and checks availability before creating the order. Keeping separate stock per outlet is a Pro feature.

Which product types work at the POS?

The free version handles simple WooCommerce products. Variable products and more advanced product workflows are handled in Pro.

Does the POS work offline?

No. The free version needs a connection to your site. Offline order handling with later sync is a Pro feature.

Will it work on a tablet?

Yes. The POS screen is a web page, so it runs in the browser on a tablet, laptop, or desktop. Installing it as a Progressive Web App with your own icon and colours is a Pro feature.

Can cashiers add customers during a sale?

Yes. Cashiers can search, add, edit, and delete customers from the POS screen, and the records save as normal WooCommerce customers. You can also set a guest account for walk-in sales.

Can I apply a coupon at the counter?

Yes. WooCommerce coupon codes can be entered and validated during POS checkout.

Is it suitable for a grocery or convenience store?

Yes. Fast product search, barcode scanning, cash payment with change, and receipt printing cover a typical grocery counter. Choose grocery/retail mode on the outlet.

Does it support restaurant tables?

Restaurant/cafe mode adds a tables tab in the POS, and the table is saved with the order. Kitchen display screens and advanced order routing are Pro features.

What happens if a customer walks away mid-sale?

Hold the cart, serve the next person, and open the held cart again when they come back.

How do I change the POS URL?

Go to MultiPOS > Configuration > General and update the POS terminal URL path. If the page does not load afterwards, save your permalinks once from Settings > Permalinks.

Do cashiers need WordPress admin access?

No. Cashiers log in on the POS screen itself and never see the WordPress dashboard.

Is MultiPOS compatible with HPOS?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Where can I get help?

Ask on the WordPress.org support forum, read the documentation at devdiggers.com/multipos-point-of-sale-for-woocommerce/, or contact DevDiggers from devdiggers.com/contact/.
